items.title: Milton Batiste Interview, 1997-02-05
items.q: relationships is so closer to me now... when I was Ritim and Blues and running on the road by G. Clark and Shirley and Lee Witherspoon and Jimmy Liggins and all that

ctx.x: And it's the basic foundation for all the other musics that have come from that era. Right. Yeah. So it's a lot of relationships is so closer to me now as an older person than it was when I was Ritim and Blues and running on the road by G. Clark and Shirley and Lee Witherspoon and Jimmy Liggins and all that when I was a teenager.
